linear.issue.state_history_empty.rule: A new issue writes state_history_json = '[]' (NOT NULL, no default, absent from the export).

linear.issue.lifecycle.rule: Completed-type states (Done, In Review) carry completed_at and no canceled_at; canceled-type states (Canceled, Duplicate) carry canceled_at and no completed_at; any other state carries neither; created <= started <= completed/canceled <= updated. Checked on the post-overlay state, so it covers issue_update records too.

linear.issue.updated_at_follows_comments.rule: An issue's updated_at is at least its lifecycle stamps and its newest comment: derived as max(created_at, started_at, completed_at, canceled_at, newest spec comment) for a new issue unless authored; a base issue receiving newer comments or stamps gets UPDATE ... SET updated_at = <newest of them>.
